project_type: PHP 8 + MySQL backend (api/*.php) with a vanilla-JS ES-module frontend (js/, js/pages/). INR-denominated Bitcoin-tracking index unit called ARV. No build step, no framework, deployed on Hostinger shared hosting.
language: PHP 8.4 (backend), ES2015 JavaScript modules (frontend). No TypeScript, no bundler.
build_system: None. Files served as-is. Charts use lightweight-charts 4.2.3 via CDN.
test_framework: None. No unit tests, no CI. Verification is `php -l` syntax checks and `node --check` parse checks plus hand-reasoning of money invariants.
build_command: No build. Syntax-check PHP: for f in api/*.php *.php; do php -l "$f"; done
test_command: No automated tests. Parse-check JS: env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check <file>.js for every changed js/*.js and js/pages/*.js and arv-config.js.
verification_instructions: 1) php -l every changed PHP file (must say 'No syntax errors detected'). 2) env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check every changed .js file. 3) Reason money-path invariants by hand. NO MySQL / exchange / WebSocket in sandbox: migration execution, backfill, ingest, matching, live tick streaming CANNOT be run here and MUST be validated on the live install.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. arv_candles / asset_candles / fx_rates are generated at runtime by cron/web-tick against live exchange APIs and stored in MySQL; not in the repo, not reproducible in sandbox.
setup_instructions: Production: MySQL DB, deploy, open install.php, add cron (curl .../api/cron.php?job=all every minute). See SETUP.md. Not reproducible in this sandbox.
environment_constraints: PHP 8.4 CLI available for php -l. Node available for node --check (use env -u NODE_OPTIONS). NO MySQL, NO mail, NO exchange network in sandbox. All runtime behaviour (migration, backfill, ingest, matching, price feed) is UNVERIFIABLE here and deferred to the live install. Network mode: repo access only.
contribution_requirements: Preserve money invariants (README + file headers): integer paise for rupees, DECIMAL(28,8)/units*1e8 for units, NO floats on the money path, append-only ledger (MySQL triggers), every fill at the index price, issuance cannot move price, stale feed pauses trading. Settings defaults in _schema.php do NOT update an installed DB; live installs migrate via arv_migrations() gated on ARV_SCHEMA_VERSION. Keep silver-on-black design and existing CSS classes.

root_cause_finding: The end spike + wrong +34027% come from a MIXED-ANCHOR arv_candles series on live installs. The v8 migration moved the four anchor settings (Rs.1/2021 -> Rs.1.78/2015) and re-queued auto_backfill_next='1D' expecting ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE to overwrite old candles with new-anchor values. BUT auto_backfill_step() SKIPS any timeframe whose stored row count already exceeds auto_backfill_floor(tf) (see _feed.php auto_backfill_step: `if ($have >= auto_backfill_floor($tf)) { advance without refetching }`). A pre-rescale install already had a full 1m series (>=5000 rows, 1m floor) and often full 1D, so those timeframes are advanced past WITHOUT being recomputed. Result: historical arv_candles keep OLD-anchor values (~Rs.2-3) while every new ingest_prices() minute is computed by index_price() against the NEW anchor (~Rs.1000) -> a vertical discontinuity at the right edge. Separately, window_stats() sinceLaunchPct = (nav-base)/base uses the NEW base (1.78) against a nav that on the old-anchor body / mixed series is internally inconsistent, so the % is nonsense (+34027%). Because arv_candles are pure display/market data (ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE, no money), a full recompute/rescale of ALL arv_candles to the current anchor is safe and is the fix. The v8 UNIT rescale (wallets/lots) must NOT run again - guard on the existing units_rescaled_v8 flag; the new corrective step touches ONLY candles + backfill scheduling, never unit balances or the ledger.
key_patterns: NAV = index_price(btcUsd, fx) in _money.php = base * (btcNow*fxNow)/(baseUsd*baseFx). arv_nav() reads the latest 1m arv_candles.close. Candles served by api/market.php handle_candles/handle_snapshot; window_stats() computes 24h + sinceLaunchPct. Live USD/INR is ALREADY on the snapshot payload as index.fxUsdInr (market.php handle_snapshot builds it from fx_rates latest). Frontend: js/ui.js has fmtPrice(rupees, decimals) and paintPrice(target, price, key, decimals) as the single funnel; snapshot is held per page as st.snap and index as st.snap.index (with .fxUsdInr, .base, .baseBtcInr). Config: arv-config.js FEED.fx.fallbackRate = 94.95 (fallback USD/INR); INDEX.priceDecimals=4; UI.currencySymbol.
